name: [🧪] Ragdoll Research
desc:
Ragdolls + Silly Shenanigans. What could go wrong?

-RAGDOLLS-
👨‍🦲React to the world around them
⚔️Can fight and be aggressive to one another
🫠Apply heavy weight and watch them SQUISH

-GEAR UP-
💪Use powers from famous fictional characters
🔫Shoot, slice, bite, inject and see the effects
💉Inject mutations into Ragdolls and unlock new journal entries
⭐Unlock Weapon Variants for playing the game

-PERFECT PHYSICS-
🏢Throw ragdolls off TALL buildings and watch them CRUSH
🚗Drive a car, or make ragdolls a test dummy and CRASH them
👥Full MULTIPLAYER - Grab and Fling your Friends

🎮Available on Mobile, Tablet, Desktop, Console
🎮Full Motion Control VR

llm.loop: spawn ragdolls in a test lab -> crush, shoot, inject and fling them -> unlock journal entries and weapon variants
llm.objectives: experiment on ragdolls to unlock journal entries and weapon variants
llm.progression: mutation journal entries, weapon variants, badges
llm.instructions: ragdolls react, fight and squish; use superpowers; shoot, slice, inject mutations; throw them off buildings; crash cars; grab and fling friends
unique: mutation journal unlocked by injecting ragdolls
llm.thumbnails: blocky ragdoll under a hydraulic press, scientist with laser, SUPERPOWER PHYSICS, INJECT MUTATIONS, DYNAMIC CRUSHING text
llm.complexity_notes: reactive ragdoll AI, many tools and powers, cross-platform plus VR
